exposure: time of the day of HM sample collection
season of the year of HM sample collection
cohort: The study included 340 lactating Finnish mothers providing human milk samples at 2 months postpartum.
finding: The strongest predictors of human milk cortisol concentration were the season of the year of sample collection and parity status, with higher concentrations observed in samples collected in summer and for primiparas compared to multiparas.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was included as a potential predictor but was not identified as a strong or robust predictor of human milk cortisol concentration.
